offering_description.value: Distributes metalworking tools, MRO supplies and other industrial consumables to manufacturers and maintenance departments. Sells mainly through a catalog, website and field sales reps, and ships from its own distribution centers.

primary_products.value: cutting tools; abrasives; fasteners; power tools; safety and janitorial supplies

primary_services.value: vending and inventory management; tool crib management; supply chain services

customer_segment.value: B2B: manufacturers, machine shops, fabricators, maintenance and repair departments

revenue_model.value: product sales: industrial supplies and tools sold to business customers; service fees: on-site vending, inventory management and tool crib services

value_chain_position.value: distributor: buys from manufacturers and sells to industrial business customers; service provider: runs inventory and supply programs at customer sites, sold to plants and shops

geography_served.value: US national: all US states, served through branches and distribution centers across the country

specialization.value: related lines: metalworking tools, fasteners, abrasives, safety and MRO supplies sold to the same industrial customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: field sales reps calling on industrial accounts; online: company website for ordering and account management; own locations: branches and distribution centers that stock and ship orders; other: printed catalogs and telephone sales for customer ordering
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; online; own locations; other

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: DOT and hazardous materials shipping rules for chemicals and tools, plus product safety standards
